text.insert: Select the Discord channels that contain decompilation knowledge for this game. The source configuration identifies the server and channels, while captured messages and their search indexes stay in the game's knowledge directory. Declare the source disabled or unavailable if no channels are selected.

steps.text: Record the server ID, channel IDs, and intended thread coverage. Select channels for this game, even when the server hosts several projects.
Verify that the configured acquisition tool can read the selected channels. Set the source's game identity, adapter, refresh policy, and game-relative capture paths.
Run the configured acquisition stage, then import the captured messages and build the required search indexes. Keep acquisition failures visible.
Find a known message through the knowledge tools and verify its channel, author, timestamp, content, and citation. Record readiness only after the required processing stages succeed.

through a game-relative script binding. Pass the source root, channel configuration, and raw archive root explicitly. The helper keeps its message database under the game's source root and loads the existing discord-cli credential file without copying the token. Bootstrap captures channel history. Thread coverage requires separately selected channels or an adapter that enumerates threads. A failed channel command returns failure even if existing messages can still be exported.
